sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.text: Software engineer with a focus on Domain-Driven Design, modular monoliths and event-driven systems. I have been building software for over 15 years, first through volunteer open-source and community projects and professionally since 2019, using PHP/Laravel and TypeScript. My focus is Domain-Driven Design, modular monoliths (package-oriented architecture), event-driven systems, and clean, test-driven code. On a greenfield POS platform I designed and own specific components end-to-end: a real-time pivot-event synchronization mechanism (Mercure/SSE) and an external REST API with a multi-tenant permission system. I value Clean Code, design patterns, and quality discipline (PHPStan level 9, BDD). I like to understand a system end-to-end, measure the results, and keep improving it. Currently deepening cloud architecture, Kubernetes, and message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ).

sections.heading: SKILLS
lines: Architecture & Quality: Software Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), modular monolith / package-oriented architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, System Design, SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code, Requirements Engineering, PHPStan level 9 (Larastan), BDD (Gherkin/Behat), PHPUnit, Pest, Codeception, Static Analysis, Performance Optimization, Security

Backend: PHP (OOP), Laravel, API Platform (REST + OpenAPI), Laravel Octane, Laravel Horizon (Redis queues), Mercure / Server-Sent Events (SSE), JWT, Symfony, Doctrine ORM, REST APIs, OAuth, Guzzle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis
Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS
Python & Data: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, NumPy, Numba (JIT), pytest, backtesting, data pipelines, algorithm optimization
AI & LLM Engineering: Agentic AI, AI Agents, LLM integration, Prompt Engineering, MCP, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AI-assisted development (Claude Code)
DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, DDEV, GitLab CI/CD, Git, Linux, Apache, Composer, npm
Currently learning: cloud architecture, Kubernetes, Kafka / RabbitMQ, OpenTelemetry

items.title: AI-Assisted Web Development
bullets: Core contributor (top 3 of a ~7-person team) on a greenfield restaurant point-of-sale (POS) platform: a distributed, layered system built on a Domain-Driven, package-oriented Laravel monolith (14 domains, 8 internal Composer packages).

Designed and own the real-time pivot-event synchronization mechanism (a custom laravel-pivot-events package plus a dedicated PivotEvents domain, pushed via Mercure/SSE) within an event-driven architecture backed by Redis queues (Laravel Horizon) and Laravel Octane.

Designed the platform's external REST API end-to-end (API Platform) with multi-tenant, permission-scoped access control: row-level query extensions, tenant-isolation write guards, JWT-based API credentials and permission management, and OpenAPI documentation.
Automated tests across the stack (PHPUnit, BDD with Behat/Gherkin and Pest, Selenium) within a GitLab CI pipeline enforcing PHPStan level 9 (Larastan) and ECS code style.

items.title: Software Development (AI-Assisted)
bullets: Conceived requirements-appropriate custom software and designed the underlying database systems (ticketing systems, web applications, marketing tools) end to end, from requirements engineering to implementation and maintenance.

Wrote user stories with the development team and clients, reviewed and approved programming work, and coordinated technical work within the team - early technical-leadership and design responsibility.
Automated tests with PHPUnit and documented code with PHPDoc; used AI tools productively for code analysis, architectural design, and automation.

items.title: Development & Coordination
bullets: Long-term team development of a large PHP browser game as a major contributor; modernizing a historically-grown legacy codebase toward Symfony and Doctrine ORM (incl. migrations).
Analyzing complex legacy dependencies and identifying technical coupling without existing documentation before making changes; refactoring while preserving the existing architecture.
Coordinating a ~10-person team and documenting technical processes and domain rules in MediaWiki.

items.title: Trading Research & Backtesting Platform
bullets: Designed an algorithmic trading and backtesting system in Python on the event-driven NautilusTrader framework, including walk-forward validation and Monte Carlo portfolio simulation.
Built a distributed signal-trading system (FastAPI dashboard, multiple Docker containers, MetaTrader 5 integration) with layered risk management and extensive test coverage (pytest).
Performance engineering: evaluated very large parameter spaces via vectorization and JIT compilation (NumPy, Numba) instead of brute-force loops.

items.title: Laravel Pivot Events - custom-IDs feature (open-source contribution)
bullets: Extended an existing open-source Laravel package with support for custom IDs and timestamps on pivot tables; worked within its Eloquent relationship internals (BelongsToMany/MorphToMany, model events).

items.title: AI Engineering Experiments
bullets: Designed and evaluated AI workflows, agents, and integrations with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs and MCP; orchestrated multi-step tasks.
Optimized prompts and token usage, weighing cost against output quality; integrated AI into real development workflows.
